name: Simple Compare Conflict Resolution Transfer
description: Add a compact JSON import/export flow for comparison-project conflict resolutions, with article identifier matching and analyze-before-commit import preview.

userStories.title: Define conflict resolution transfer schema and helpers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a small versioned JSON contract for conflict-resolution transfer so export and import share one validated artifact shape.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a helper under `src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/` for the V1 artifact schema, ArkType validation, filename generation, identifier normalization, and row shaping.
The artifact root contains `format`, `version`, `exportedAt`, `source`, and `rows` fields without project-transfer zip/session metadata.
Each row contains `sourceResolutionId`, compact article identity fields, all available `app.article_identifier` rows, and a `resolution` object with mode, value, and label.
The helper treats `sourceArticleRowId` as provenance only and does not use it as a portable match key.
Add helper tests covering valid artifacts, invalid artifacts, DOI normalization, and title-only rows being non-matchable.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionFileTransfer.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.

userStories.title: Add conflict resolution export endpoint
userStories.description: As a compare project user, I want to export saved conflict resolutions as a compact JSON file so I can reuse them in another comparison project.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `POST /api/comparison-projects/:id/conflict-resolutions/export` in `src/server/routes/ComparisonProjectsRoutes.ts`.
The endpoint validates that the comparison project exists and exports all saved conflict-resolution rows for that project, independent of current table filters or pagination.
The export joins `app.comparison_project_conflict_resolution` to `app.article` and aggregates all `app.article_identifier` rows for each article.
The exported article identity includes external article ID, title, DOI, PubMed ID, arXiv ID, bioRxiv ID, medRxiv ID, URL, and canonical identifiers when available.
The response is `application/json` with a `Content-Disposition` filename like `<comparison-name>_conflict_resolutions_YYYY-MM-DD.json`.
The existing `POST /api/comparison-projects/:id/export` CSV route remains unchanged.
`bun test src/server/routes/ComparisonProjectsRoutes.rollback.test.ts` passes for export coverage.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionFileTransfer.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.

userStories.title: Extend import matching for file-backed identifiers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want file-backed resolution rows to match target articles by exact normalized identifiers so imports are safe and explainable.
acceptanceCriteria: Adapt exported JSON rows into the existing conflict-resolution import planner source-row shape where possible.
Extend matching to support canonical `kind + normalizedValue` identifier pairs beyond DOI, including PMID and arXiv when present.
Keep DOI as the strongest match key, followed by canonical identifiers, legacy stable IDs, and then external article ID plus normalized title.
Never match by title alone.
Restrict candidate target articles to the target comparison project's article scope.
Return row-level skip reasons for no usable key, no target match, ambiguous target, conflicting identifiers, invalid value, not conflicting, existing target resolution, and unsupported mode.
Add tests for DOI, PMID, arXiv, external ID plus title, title-only skip, ambiguous target skip, and identifiers pointing to different target articles.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionImport.test.ts` passes.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionFileTransfer.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.

userStories.title: Add conflict resolution import analyze endpoint
userStories.description: As a compare project user, I want to analyze a resolution import before committing so I can see exactly what will and will not be imported.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `POST /api/comparison-projects/:id/conflict-resolutions/import/analyze`.
The endpoint accepts the parsed JSON artifact in the request body and does not create a server-side upload session in V1.
The endpoint validates the target comparison project exists, has conflict resolution enabled, and is summary mode for V1 imports.
Prompt-mode artifact rows are skipped with `skippedUnsupportedMode` instead of being imported.
The response includes `source`, `summary`, `importableRows`, `skippedRows`, and `warnings` at stable field names.
Importable and skipped rows include source title, source IDs, target title when known, target IDs when known, selected resolution, match kind, match key, and reason.

The summary includes scanned, matched, importable, deduped, skipped, skippedExisting, skippedUnsupportedMode, skippedNoUsableKey, skippedNoTargetMatch, skippedNotConflicting, skippedAmbiguousTarget, skippedConflicting, and skippedInvalidValue counts.
`bun test src/server/routes/ComparisonProjectsRoutes.rollback.test.ts` passes for analyze route coverage.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionImport.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.

userStories.title: Add conflict resolution import commit endpoint
userStories.description: As a compare project user, I want to commit only the safe analyzed resolution rows so existing target decisions and unsafe matches are preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `POST /api/comparison-projects/:id/conflict-resolutions/import/commit`.
The endpoint accepts the same parsed JSON artifact as analyze and re-runs analysis during commit.
The commit runs in one transaction and inserts only still-safe candidates into `app.comparison_project_conflict_resolution`.
Summary-mode imports insert `prompt_id = NULL` and `answer_value = <target option value>`.
Existing target conflict-resolution rows are not overwritten by default and are reported as `skippedExisting`.
The response returns the same summary shape as analyze plus `inserted`.
Add tests proving commit writes safe rows, skips existing target rows, and skips rows that became unsafe after preview.
`bun test src/server/routes/ComparisonProjectsRoutes.rollback.test.ts` passes for commit route coverage.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionImport.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.

userStories.title: Add client service methods for resolution transfer
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I want typed client methods for resolution export, analyze, and commit so the UI can use the new routes consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Add service types for the export artifact, analyze preview, skipped rows, warnings, and commit response in `src/services/comparisonProjectsService.ts`.
Add client methods for export, analyze import, and commit import using nearby comparison project service patterns.
Preserve Eden/TanStack Query conventions used by nearby compare project code.
Use existing API URL helpers for browser and desktop compatibility.
Do not introduce generic service files outside the local comparison project service unless existing patterns require it.
`bun test src/server/routes/ComparisonProjectsRoutes.rollback.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.

userStories.title: Add detail page export and import entry points
userStories.description: As a compare project user, I want clear resolution import/export actions on the comparison detail page so I can transfer decisions from the target project context.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `Export resolutions` on `src/app/routes/+compare-judgments/+$id/+index.tsx` near the existing `Export data` action.
The export action downloads the JSON artifact returned by the new export endpoint.
Add `Import resolutions` next to `Export resolutions` when `allowConflictResolution` is enabled.
The import action links to `/compare-judgments/:id/import-resolutions`.
When conflict resolution is disabled, hide or disable `Import resolutions` with copy explaining that the target comparison project must allow conflict resolution.
The existing CSV `Export data` action remains unchanged.
`bun test <new compare detail import/export UI test>` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
Browser verify the compare detail page shows the correct export/import actions.
Run `bun run desktop:build` if shared upload/download wiring, runtime paths, or API URL helpers changed.

userStories.title: Build import page analyze preview
userStories.description: As a compare project user, I want an import page that analyzes a selected JSON file before commit so I can review importable and skipped decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/app/routes/+compare-judgments/+$id/+import-resolutions.tsx` for `/compare-judgments/:id/import-resolutions`.
The page title is `Import conflict resolutions` and it shows the target comparison project name.
The page explains that import only adds saved conflict-resolution decisions to articles already present in the target comparison project.
The page lets the user choose or drop a `.json` conflict-resolution export file and shows a clear invalid-file error when JSON parsing fails.
Clicking `Analyze import` calls the analyze endpoint with the parsed artifact.
The analyze result shows summary counts, a table of rows that will be imported, and a table of rows that will not be imported.
Skipped rows show source article details, attempted target details when known, selected resolution, match kind, match key, and skip reason.
`Commit import` is disabled until analyze succeeds and at least one row is importable.
`bun test <new compare detail import/export UI test>` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
Browser verify selecting a file, analyzing it, and seeing importable/skipped rows.
Run `bun run desktop:build` if shared upload/download wiring, runtime paths, or API URL helpers changed.

userStories.title: Add import page commit flow
userStories.description: As a compare project user, I want to commit the analyzed import and return to the comparison with imported resolutions visible.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking `Commit import` calls the commit endpoint with the same parsed artifact used for analyze.
The page handles commit loading and error states without losing the selected artifact or analyze result.
After commit, the page shows inserted and skipped counts from the server response.
After commit, the page provides a link back to `/compare-judgments/:id`.
Returning to the comparison detail invalidates or refreshes comparison judgment queries so imported resolutions appear in the table.
The commit flow remains disabled when analyze has no importable rows.
`bun test <new compare detail import/export UI test>` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
Browser verify analyzing, committing, returning to the comparison, and seeing imported resolutions in the table.
Run `bun run desktop:build` if shared upload/download wiring, runtime paths, or API URL helpers changed.

userStories.title: Add comparison grid export shortcut
userStories.description: As a compare project user, I want an optional grid-level export shortcut so I can download resolution artifacts without first opening the detail page.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a secondary `Export resolutions` action on comparison project cards in `src/components/main/comparisonProjectsGrid.tsx` after the detail-page flow is working.
The grid action downloads the same JSON artifact as the detail page export action.
Do not add grid-level import in V1 because import requires a target comparison project context and analyze preview.
Keep existing comparison project card actions, including `Export data`, unchanged.
`bun test <new compare detail import/export UI test>` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
